input: Which of Quillmoor Capital, Vellisk Partners and Orrindale Fund has the strongest fintech track record? Give numbers.

rounds.answer:
**Quillmoor Capital** has the strongest fintech track record of the three, based on the number of fintech companies in its portfolio.

| Firm | Fintech companies | Total portfolio | Investment years |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quillmoor Capital | 6 | 6 (all fintech) | 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026 |
| Vellisk Partners | 2 | 2 (all fintech) | 2022, 2024 |
| Orrindale Fund | 1 | 2 (the other is proptech) | 2023, 2024 |

- **Quillmoor:** It was founded in 2014 and has made fintech investments across seven years. Its focus areas are fintech, insurtech and regtech.
- **Vellisk:** It was founded in 2018. Both of its portfolio companies are fintech.
- **Orrindale:** It was founded in 2020 and invests at pre-seed and seed. One of its two portfolio companies is fintech.

The dataset has no information on exits, returns or follow-on rounds. "Track record" here therefore means the number and spread of fintech deals, not performance.
